lives.title: Parallel Programming Course Launch
lives.subtitle: Curriculum walkthrough: one problem, several machines
lives.topic: New Parallel Computing course + full curriculum
lives.audience: Students and engineers learning parallel / HPC programming
lives.cta: Start the free course after the live
agenda: Why this course exists (one problem across many machines)
How the curriculum is structured (8 chapters, 52 lessons)
Chapter tour: Thinking → CPU → OpenMP → Algorithms → SIMD → GPU → MPI → Measuring
How to study: read one page, do the exercise, take the quiz
Q&A and what to study next
talkingPoints: The course keeps one running example (a list of integers) while the execution model changes.
Correctness comes first: races, shared memory, and measurement are not optional side topics.
OpenMP, SIMD, GPU, and MPI are different machines for the same idea — not separate unrelated courses.
Every chapter has lessons + a quiz; projects lock the idea in.
